_comment: MCP servers Alil can reach via the on-demand mcp.* meta-tools. Tools are NEVER injected into context; the model discovers them with mcp.search → mcp.inspect → mcp.call. Empty `servers` (the default) means MCP is off. Each entry: { name, transport: 'stdio'|'http', command, args?, env?, url?, timeoutMs?, minEffect?, enabled? }. Streamable-HTTP servers use transport:'http' + url. `enabled` defaults true; set it false (or toggle it in the MCP UI tab) to make a server fully invisible to the model — dropped from search, refused by inspect/call.
